instruction: Using only the standalone learner-facing English stem, prompts, and opaque token pools, select exactly one condition, two actions, and two parameters. Return the required structured JSON, including exactly one premise row for every opaque token. Do not infer absent client-specific facts.
stem: A 19-year-old client with sickle cell disease develops new cough, dyspnea, tachypnea, and right-sided crackles. SpO₂ is 91% on room air, and the chest radiograph shows a new right-lower-lobe infiltrate. The client is alert without recent sedative exposure, jugular venous distention, or peripheral edema. Orders are available for an IV cephalosporin, an oral macrolide, supplemental oxygen, and respiratory care. Complete the bow-tie by choosing the condition, 2 actions, and 2 parameters to monitor.

actions.label: A1
actions.text: Wait for final culture results before starting respiratory treatment

actions.label: A2
actions.text: Administer a sedative to suppress cough and respiratory effort

actions.label: A3
actions.text: Administer the ordered cephalosporin and macrolide and provide supplemental oxygen

actions.label: A4
actions.text: Encourage incentive spirometry while awake and support pulmonary hygiene

parameters.label: P1
parameters.text: Joint swelling and chronic limb-pain score

parameters.label: P2
parameters.text: SpO₂, respiratory rate, work of breathing, and bronchospasm

parameters.label: P3
parameters.text: Daily weight and jugular venous pressure

parameters.label: P4
parameters.text: Hemoglobin trend and progression of pulmonary infiltrates on imaging
